description: Safety check-in tool for runners. Receives biometric data from Terra webhooks (Oura via Terra's server-side integration) and places a calm outbound phone call via the ElevenLabs Conversational AI Twilio integration when stress indicators spike.
notAnEmergencyService: Escalation to an emergency contact exists but is off by default (escalationEnabled). Even when on, Terra's stress score is a recalculated value rather than a live reading, so this is not real-time emergency detection.

auth.scheme: Admin routes require an x-admin-token header matching ADMIN_TOKEN, compared in constant time. When ADMIN_TOKEN is unset they accept loopback connections only. There is no bypass flag: these routes place real calls to the runner and her emergency contact.
auth.rejections: 401 with { status: 'error', error: 'unauthorised' }, logged with source IP

webhookHardening.signature: strict, on the raw body, before parsing
webhookHardening.rateLimit: 60 requests per minute per IP; 429 above that. Set TRUST_PROXY=1 behind a proxy so real client IPs are used.
webhookHardening.logging: every rejection is logged with source IP and reason

endpoints.description: Terra payload receiver. Verifies the terra-signature header (HMAC-SHA256 over `<timestamp>.<raw body>`, 300s window) before anything else, then acknowledges immediately and processes asynchronously because Terra retries on any non-200. Handles activity, daily and body payloads; idempotent across Terra's resends for the same period.
endpoints.body: Terra webhook payload: { type, user: { user_id, provider }, data: [ ... ] }

responses.200: { "status": "received" } — acknowledged; processing continues in the background
responses.401: { "status": "error", "error": string } — missing, malformed, stale or non-matching signature

endpoints.description: Manual trigger. Skipped when the score is below stressThreshold or a call was placed within cooldownSeconds. Responds immediately; the call is placed asynchronously.

body.context: string (optional, short description surfaced in the spoken message)

endpoints.description: Place a call directly with the supplied message, bypassing scoring, threshold and cooldown. For verifying the ElevenLabs/Twilio connection in isolation. Waits for ElevenLabs to accept the call, then tracks the outcome in the background.
Records that the runner is fine. Cancels a pending escalation that is still inside its delay window.
Platform health check, independent of call state: uptime and whether the configuration is complete. Use this for container and load-balancer probes, not /status.
Counters, the last call outcome, and readiness.

responses.200: { "nudgeCount": number, "lastNudgeAt": string|null, "lastCallOutcome": object|null, "cooldownActive": boolean, "callingConfigured": boolean, "webhookConfigured": boolean, "missingEnv": string[], "escalation": object }

escalation.fields: enabled, configured, missingEnv, lastEscalationAt, acknowledgedAt, recent
escalation.recent: the last 10 audit entries: { at, verdict, reason, triggeringScore, conversation ids, outcome }
escalation.verdicts: pending | called | cancelled | skipped | failed | outcome

lastCallOutcome.stage: which stage the call reached or failed at: message_generation | elevenlabs_call | call_outcome | complete
lastCallOutcome.fields: at, conversationId, status, callDurationSecs, terminationReason, error, details (present depending on outcome)

endpoints.description: Update non-secret config and persist to config.json. Secrets are never readable or writable here; any other key is rejected. listenerPort changes take effect on restart.

body.escalationEnabled: boolean (optional) — turning this on means an unanswered check-in will call a third party

env: ADMIN_TOKEN (shared secret for the admin routes)
TRUST_PROXY (1 when a proxy sets X-Forwarded-For)

escalation.default: disabled (escalationEnabled false) — must be switched on deliberately
escalation.flow: unanswered check-in call -> wait escalationDelaySeconds -> re-check whether the runner answered late or hit /acknowledge -> only if still unanswered, one call to EMERGENCY_CONTACT_NUMBER using ELEVENLABS_ESCALATION_AGENT_ID
escalation.rateLimit: at most one escalation per cooldownSeconds window, however many Terra payloads arrive for the same period
escalation.agent: a separate ElevenLabs agent; the third-party script does not share the runner's persona
escalation.script: factual and non-alarming: automated check-in, elevated wearable reading, no answer, may well be nothing. It does not claim an emergency or tell the contact to call emergency services.
escalation.consent: the contact is called automatically and must have consented in advance
escalation.audit: every attempt, including the ones that never dial, is logged and persisted in state.escalationLog with timestamp, triggering score and outcome

scoring.source: data_enrichment.stress from the Terra payload only; returns null and skips when absent
scoring.notImplemented: exertion-aware scoring. Raw heart rate is not a valid stress signal for a runner — elevated HR is the expected state. Real logic needs HRV against a personal baseline, or HR relative to pace.

outOfScope: Apple Health and Terra's Mobile SDK (no web API; would require an on-device app)
